name: Necromancy (Cenotaph Path) — Basic — Reveal the Catene

system.description: The Necromancer spends at least half a minute (three turns in combat time) handling and examining an object or person, then spends a Blood Trait. On a successful challenge, he determines whether the subject holds significance to any wraith as a catena (fetter), and identifies at least one such wraith if already known to him. If the object is a fetter to multiple wraiths, the power reveals this fact and may be used again to learn additional identities. A botch means the power can never be used successfully on that item again.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
